capabilities: schedule customizable review cycles (daily, weekly, monthly, long-term)
track today's, overdue, and upcoming reviews in a dashboard
link review topics to vault files and notes
snooze reviews and back up data as JSON
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition app; it schedules and tracks review sessions for your own subjects and topics.
extras: README is mostly in Persian with a shorter English section; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The README says it was built for Persian-speaking students and researchers whose main concern is not forgetting what they study.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to schedule and track recurring reviews of study material so you don't forget what you learned.
summary: Study review scheduler that manages customizable review cycles for subjects with a dashboard, per-subject checklists, Jalali calendar, and JSON backup.
